scope: Shoot identity producer-to-consumer family, direct oak-root extraction, replay revisions, and opt-in hosted export workflow only. All 18 diff paths are pinned; clouds.rs assertion removal is explicitly outside identity review. No whole-file or whole-audit clearance.
validation: Source-only independent review. No project checks, tests, lint, build, runtime probe, source edits, Git mutation, publication, or other reviewer verdict reads.
initial_inventory: Root authored preimplementation plan was consulted only for proposed scope/acceptance, never as final coverage or another reviewer verdict. Every lens above independently analyzed actual postrepair bodies, all changed hunks, actual unchanged receivers and fixture bodies.

dispositions.source_backed_assessment: All four canonical terminal source seeds flow into opaque TreeShootId, retained terminal foliage, each leaf descriptor, sort/group keys, shadow and sparse/detailed/native bake samplers, and review specimen. Conversion to Seed/u64 is at actual determinism/fingerprint APIs, whose bodies were read. No primitive identity storage remains. New test owner path is unresolved (SHOOT-CODE-1), so executable proof is pending.

Seed is canonical fixed-width derivation/random root, but not the shoot-specific role. Reuse it in the sole TreeShootId constructor and adapter; no existing shoot owner competes. Existing branch/leaf owners gain that type without inventing another quantity system. Native radii and points are unchanged numerical-kernel values; homogeneous radius pair is destructured into named end roles.

Only from_seed admits IDs; u64 field is private, no default/deserialize/reflection/raw From derive bypass. This is open identity with all bits meaningful, so zero and fullwidth are valid. Existing Seed accepts all fixed-width words. At all application producers foliage identity comes from the specific source seed; fixtures admit numeric root at authored boundary. No normalization, float inference, compatibility reconstruction or new rejection policy.

No arithmetic mutates ID; copying, equality, hashing and total ordering preserve bits. Derivation uses fixed-width little-endian hash framing. Final source fingerprint preserves u64 without f32 loss and retains intentional wrapping multiplication. Curve segmentation count/point indexing, t0/t1 and radius lerp/powf arithmetic unchanged; Some is retained only for final segment. Native nonempty authored curves remain existing premise, not newly validated public content.

One identity owner remains at existing leaves/identity, exposed through leaves then geometry for skeleton/branches and other rendering consumers. This does not create a competing skeletal identity or public crate API. SHOOT_IDENTITY purpose moves with its actual owner; StreamId literal unchanged. Removed float-derived shoot_identity facade has no compatibility alias. Correct test reference must target geometry owner (SHOOT-CODE-1).

Production TreeBranchSegment construction remains centralized in append_branch_curve; all four foliage-bearing sites supply Some and only final segment retains it. Other axes/roots/knots supply None. TreeLeaf stores ID and ordinal together, carried unchanged through copy/translation/group selection. Fields remain presentation-visible numeric geometry records, so fabricated arbitrary segment/ID combinations remain representable internal data; no promise of globally sealed segment admission is claimed. No actual bad production constructor or mutation is introduced.

is_limb_tip remains ordinary wood-geometry endpoint predicate across all axes; foliage Option identifies the independently meaningful subset and owns its payload. Consumers now derive foliage membership from Option rather than duplicating depth3+tip. The builder coordinates segment tip and Option, with no independent updates. Leaf ID is retained source identity, not a second position-derived authority. Revision18 and garden revision3 mark intentional replay change; exact asset cache receivers validate generated source hash.

Old endpoint-bit-derived identity is replaced intentionally; all shoot-salted random values (leaf posture/size/shade, sparse lane, bake phase) may change, not only sparse counts. The original four depth3 terminal producers map exactly to Some; bud/leaf population arithmetic and wood/radius arithmetic preserved. Oak-root extraction preserves original call order and trunk_points[0] argument. Existing fixture cases/oracles retained with type/metadata adaptation, but SHOOT-CODE-1 prevents test compilation. Current envelope payload and old asset/budget literals require hosted regeneration/review; no bitexact old-leaf claim or acceptance waiver.

Option<TreeShootId> expresses absent/present foliage with the meaningful identity payload. No boolean foliage flag beside optional ID is added. is_limb_tip is an independent wood predicate and must not be folded into foliage state: nonfoliage roots/trunks still have tips. workflow boolean is required GitHub dispatch representation, not a carried application semantic role.

New type uses the same visual.tree.shoot-identity stream name at its sole owner; this is a canonical deterministic purpose passed to StreamId::new, whose length-framed native hash API was read. Existing numeric fixture is not classified through prose. Workflow input/job/path/command/artifact strings are direct GitHub Actions, Cargo filter, environment variable and filesystem adapters; actual named test functions/writers and paths were read. No new raw string identity circulates through application logic.

Private ID word is semantic opaque u64, never a float. Empty derivation context is framed native RNG input; zero/fullwidth remain valid identity. Radius fixed pair has homogeneous metre role and named destructuring at documented Y-up numerical kernel; all prior literal expressions preserved. Segment index+1 is native ordinal endpoint predicate. Native FNV hash uses existing offset/prime and wrapping; new ID contributes a full word. Revisions18/3 are explicit replay invalidation adapter values, not probabilities/tolerances. Existing numeric fixture seeds remain authored literals. Broader unchanged geometry tuning/group typing is outside this bounded repair and not cleared.

TreeShootId uses standard derives for Copy/Clone/Debug/Eq/Hash/Ord/PartialEq/PartialOrd over the private word; no mechanical manual trait boilerplate introduced. from_seed performs domain-separated semantic derivation and seed() adapts to canonical native RNG input, so primitive From/transparent derivation would alter authority/admission. No serialization contract is invented.

TreeShootId prevents mixing a branch/group ordinal, generic RNG root or float geometry hash with retained shoot identity. All generated leaf/sampler fields use it, so the distinction is used beyond naming. Existing Seed is reused underneath rather than duplicated; no extra per-species wrappers or identity framework. Option supplies exactly the foliage subset distinction and independent wood-tip predicate remains simple. Stronger global uniqueness/branding or extra numerical range validation is unsupported and unnecessary.

clearance: Bounded source wave only; changes required before fixture compilation, generated artifacts pending, hosted full quality pending. No whole774/780/826 or broader32-path WIP clearance.
